{{Quick Guide}}

==Details==
{{Quest details page|Shadows of Custodia}}

==Walkthrough==

{{Checklist|
*Read the Noticeboard in the [[Auburn Pub]] {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Talk to [[Marcus]] in the bar
*Talk to the Bartender {{Chat option|2About the missing people...}}
*Talk to [[Ictus]] north of the Quetzal and west of the nearby hill
*Talk to [[Captain Ariadna]] in south-west Auburnvale, between the two guard towers
*Talk to [[Francis (Auburnvale)|Francis]] or [[Aemilia]] in the house west of the bar
*Inspect the western wall outside of their house then follow path of red marks to the river west of town.
*Inspect the plank to use fishing rod (Fishing Rod Spawn just south west of floating plank) to fish up cloth
*Return to Francis or Aemilia with the cloth
*Follow the path indicated by the puddles west of town, then north around the mountain, until reaching a cave. Enter the cave
*Talk to [[injured boy]]
*Talk to Francis or Aemilia
*Speak to [[Captain Ariadna]] at the West Entrance to town with 4 willow longbows ([[Renu]] to [[Arcuani's Archery Supplies|Tal Teklan Archery shop]] for quick bows)
*Reinforce the west Wall of the house with the boys with 4x Maple Logs and a hammer. (Hammer be found in the house to the north. Maple Trees can be chopped nearby.)
*Return to Francis or Aemilia, go upstairs and speak to [[Etz]] & [[Shas]] (the former injured boy(s))
*Go back to the cave west of town
*Talk to [[Antos]] (east side of the cave) and be prepared to kill 3 [[Strange creature (Shadows of Custodia)|Strange Creatures]] - protect from melee works but you can still take bleed damage.
*Talk to Antos again to return to Auburnvale.
*Talk to Captain Ariadna
*Quest Complete
}}
